facts.cliff-edge: He stands at the edge of a rocky cliff, and the drop begins right in front of his feet.
facts.gaze-up: His head is tilted back, and he looks up at the sky instead of down at his feet.
facts.staff-bundle: A black staff held in his right hand rests over his shoulder, with a small bundle hanging from its end.
facts.white-rose: In his left hand he lightly holds a single white rose.
facts.white-dog: At the lower right, a small white dog leaps up with a front paw raised.
facts.sun-corner: In the upper right corner of the yellow sky, a white sun sends out rays.
facts.tunic: He wears a tunic with round flowers on a black ground, yellow boots, and a red feather in his hair.
facts.snow-peaks: Behind him, white snow-covered mountain peaks can be seen.

glosses.cliff-edge: A first step taken before the outcome is fully known.
glosses.white-dog: Read as an instinct that is excited along with him, or as a warning to look once more.

reversedGloss.excess: Excitement runs ahead, and he leaps in without checking the ground under his feet.
reversedGloss.blocked: He wants to step forward, but fear or circumstances hold him back from the first step.
reversedGloss.internalized: Outwardly he stands still, but inwardly he is already getting ready to leave.

misdescriptions.wrong: He is falling off the cliff.
The dog is biting his leg and holding him back.
He walks with his eyes closed.
